name: Ruth McKee AlGhamdi
title: Journalist, media trainer and executive coach
bio_short: Financial journalist, media trainer and executive coach with more than 16 years' experience across the Middle East. Former MENA Bureau Chief for Mergermarket. Specialist in financial communications, investor relations and corporate writing.
bio: Ruth is a financial journalist, media trainer and executive coach with more than 16 years' experience across the Middle East and North Africa. As MENA Bureau Chief for Mergermarket (part of Acuris), she developed extensive experience interviewing senior executives and shareholders across all industries on strategic matters including mergers and acquisitions, IPOs, joint ventures and growth strategy.  Ruth specialises in financial and corporate communications. Recent work includes developing annual report content for regional banks in the UAE and Saudi Arabia, preparing the management team of a Saudi human resources company for their equity story and investor roadshow ahead of a Tadawul listing, and writing strategic content for a major Saudi government-owned entertainment development company. She has appeared regularly on CNBC Arabia to discuss M&A and investment trends, and chairs and moderates at business conferences and events.  At ISOC, Ruth delivers corporate and financial communications, media training and executive coaching programmes. Her financial journalism background makes her particularly effective at preparing spokespeople and executive teams for financial media, investor engagements and the communication challenges that surround transactions, listings and strategic announcements. Ruth is based between Dubai and Riyadh and trains in English.
